heading: Pace check
sub: Before a group hike: about how long this route takes
lead: Upload one recent hike (a GPX or FIT recorded by a watch or a hiking app) and the route you plan to walk: you get about how many hours the route takes, and whether that is faster or slower than an ordinary hiker.
privacy: The files are used for the calculation only and dropped right after; nothing is kept.
track.hint: The recording needs its times. With a group you walk at the group's pace, so the range comes out wider.
route.hint: No pack given: 4 kg for one day, 9 kg for several.
note.limits: With a single recorded hike the range is wide; the error grows when the pack or the altitude differ a lot from that hike.
note.stops: Stops (rests, meals, photos) use a typical hiking share while there is little to go on.
join.title: Compare with your own pace?
join.text: Signed in, the same route also shows how much faster or slower than you, from the hikes in your account.
you_s: you take about {h} h on it
basis: Estimated from the one hike you gave ({km} km, {gain} m climbed, {kind})
err.files: Pick a recorded hike and a route
